name: Red Lady

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health. Every 20-30 seconds she calls summoned innocents (up to nine alive); they cast disease.
Her Soul Drain hits everyone within 350 for 100 matter damage every 3 seconds for 30 seconds.
She cannot be hurt outside her tether.

story:
The Red Lady keened for the innocent: the herders and children and hostages who died in Caimheul's wars and were owed a song of their own. When the voice from below changed her keen, they came back first. They come still, whenever she is threatened, small and sick and bewildered, and they carry their sickness to whoever they touch. She does not use them cruelly. She simply cannot bear to let them go. Her own song settles on those who stand near her as a slow drawing-out of the soul, a grief that takes as it grieves.

She was the middle sister, the one who sang for those who had no one else to sing for them. In a chieftain's wars it is not only warriors who die: herders die, and children, and hostages, and the old who could not run. The Red Lady's keen was for them, and she was proud of it, the keeners' daughters say, because it was the one keen nobody paid for.

When the voice changed the song, they came back first. They come still, whenever she is threatened, eight at a time and never more than nine about her: small, sick, bewildered figures in the clothes of a hundred years ago, and they carry their sickness to whoever they touch. She does not send them as weapons. She calls them home, and they come, and they are sick. Her own keen settles on those who stand near her as a slow drawing-out of the soul, a grief that takes as it grieves, and every few breaths it settles again. The Red Lady and the Blue are the only ones the Black Lady still listens to, and when either is threatened, the keen from the grove grows louder.
legend: Her innocents keep coming every half minute and they spread disease: kill them fast, cure the sick. Do not stand bunched near her or her soul drain eats the whole group. Fight her in her room. Some say it is cruel to kill the innocents. They are already dead. Clerics should carry cure disease above everything. The innocents are weak, a few blows each, so AoE them as they arrive and keep the drain off the healers by keeping them back from her. Superstition: never whistle a lullaby in her room. She takes it for an answer, and more of the little ones come.

loremasterTopic.text: She keened for the innocent dead of the chieftain's wars, and they come back to her, sick and lost. Her keen drains the souls of those near her.

bookPage: From Nóra's book: the Red Lady was my mother's favourite of the three, which my mother said was a terrible thing to admit. She sang for the ones nobody paid to mourn, the herders and the children and the old who die in a chieftain's wars without a name. When the song changed, they came back to her first, sick and frightened, and she cannot bear to send them away. The realm's raiders must kill the little ones as they come. My mother asked me to write this here: they are already dead. It is not cruelty to let them lie down.
